# Frontmatter Gen (frontmatter-gen)
> Zero-copy frontmatter extraction and multi-format parsing library and CLI for YAML 1.2, TOML, and JSON in Rust with HTML meta tag generation and zero unsafe code.

## Supported Frontmatter Formats
- YAML 1.2: Standard `---` fence extraction and full YAML 1.2 parsing via `noyalib` (including explicit tags via `Value::Tagged`)
- TOML 1.1: Standard `+++` fence extraction and TOML 1.1 parsing via `toml`
- JSON: Leading `Ellipsis` object or fenced JSON block extraction and parsing via `serde_json`
- Automatic Detection: `detect_format` and `extract` inspect fence delimiters or leading tokens automatically

## Core Capabilities & Assurance
- Zero-Copy Extraction: `extract_raw_frontmatter` splits `(raw_frontmatter, body)` as borrowed `&str` slices without heap allocation
- Configurable DoS Budgets: `ParseOptions` enforces `max_depth`, `max_keys`, and required-key validation (`validate: true`)
- SEO & Meta Tag Synthesis: `meta::generate_metatags` produces escaped HTML `<meta>`, Open Graph, and Twitter Card tags
- Formal Verification & Fuzzing: `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, Miri verified under Tree Borrows, 4 `cargo-fuzz` targets (`Arbitrary`), and 100% unit test coverage
